description: This bar chart, titled “PolitiFact,” presents two sets of accuracy percentages for a multimodal misinformation detection system under varying conditions, with the left panel representing the “Ours” model and the right panel representing the “PolitiFact” model. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 75.0 to 95.0 in increments of 2.5, using a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists six categories: “Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o text,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition,” arranged in a consistent order across both panels. Each bar is color-coded and labeled with its exact accuracy percentage. In the “Ours” panel, the bars show accuracies of 89.84% (maroon), 86.82% (orange), 80.10% (light yellow), 88.80% (light blue), 87.34% (cyan), and 87.17% (dark blue). In the “PolitiFact” panel, the corresponding bars show accuracies of 90.57% (maroon), 85.85% (orange), 83.02% (light yellow), 89.62% (light blue), 84.91% (cyan), and 87.74% (dark blue). The bars are not sorted and are presented in the same order for both panels, with no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any specific bar.
